task.title: Claim the next available recurrence occurrence through the CLI

Delegate replay, snapshot guards, selection, and claim append to the kernel.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.

attempts.patch: Implemented the issue 953 contract in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests and synchronized architecture and behavior documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found unbounded WrongExpectedVersion retries could prevent return; commit a4c543f capped retries at four, added typed exhaustion evidence and deterministic tests, and synchronized documentation.
attempts.patch: Applied blocking findings where present, reran verification, required substantive review, and preserved zero unresolved review threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 953 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 954 exact head

lessons: Optimistic retry loops at external boundaries must be bounded.
Typed retry exhaustion preserves deterministic caller control.
The CLI adds no ambient time, task identity, durable cursor, dispatch, permission, or execution authority.
